sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN i.total END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.billing_country = 'Germany' THEN i.total END), 0) AS share FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01';
